sections.title: Agent Training Frameworks
sections.description: Agent loops, harness integration, trajectory abstractions, and multi-agent execution.

sections.title: Rollout Execution and Scheduling
sections.description: Asynchronous pipelines, synchronous long-tail mitigation, policy synchronization, cache placement, and heterogeneous resources. Reasoning-only systems are identified in the summaries.

sections.title: General RL Training Systems
sections.description: Distributed RLHF and RLVR foundations. Inclusion here does not imply that the original paper implements multi-turn agents.

sections.title: Environments and Data Pipelines
sections.description: Executable tasks, sandbox measurements, environment construction, and verification. These are complementary to the optimizer and trainer.

sections.title: Algorithm-System Co-design
sections.description: Optimization and diagnostics that constrain how asynchronous samples, policy versions, and training signals should be handled.

sections.title: Multimodal and Embodied Systems
sections.description: Visual web interaction and VLA training, where screenshots, rendering, or simulators add different resource demands.

sections.title: Online Learning Architecture
sections.description: Trajectory protocols, data governance, and control-plane proposals for learning from deployed agents.

papers.title: AgentRL: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning with a Multi-Turn, Multi-Task Framework
papers.name: AgentRL
papers.summary_en: Combines fully asynchronous generation and training with a unified function-call API, containerized environments, and a central controller. Cross-policy sampling and task advantage normalization address exploration and multi-task optimization.
papers.summary_zh: 将全异步生成与训练、统一函数调用接口、容器化环境和集中控制器结合。通过跨策略采样与任务优势归一化，处理探索及多任务优化问题。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: Agent Lightning: Train ANY AI Agents with Reinforcement Learning
papers.name: Agent Lightning
papers.summary_en: Decouples agent execution from RL training through a unified transition interface. LightningRL assigns credit within agent trajectories, supporting existing agent implementations and dynamic workflows.
papers.summary_zh: 通过统一转移接口，将智能体执行与 RL 训练解耦。LightningRL 在智能体轨迹内分配信用，支持已有智能体实现和动态工作流。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: Towards Harnessed Agentic RL
papers.name: Agent Lightning v1.0
papers.summary_en: Keeps the deployment harness in control of tools, context, and interaction while the trainer observes model requests and responses. Studies retokenization, sample merging, advantage calculation, loss normalization, and backend scheduling.
papers.summary_zh: 由部署时使用的 harness 控制工具、上下文和交互，训练器观测模型请求与响应。研究重新分词、样本合并、优势计算、损失归一化和后端调度。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history
papers.audit_note: A separate technical report, not a revision of arXiv:2508.03680. The first submission is August 18, despite the August 19 date in the project README.

papers.title: AgentFly: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Unified Resource System
papers.name: AgentFly
papers.summary_en: The reviewed revision manages sandboxes, model services, and APIs as typed resources in one scheduling engine. Its agent, rollout, context, and resource layers support multi-turn reuse, asynchronous backpressure, and scoped resource lifecycles.
papers.summary_zh: 所核验版本将沙箱、模型服务与 API 作为类型化资源，交由统一引擎调度。智能体、采样、上下文和资源四层设计支持多轮复用、异步背压及分作用域的资源生命周期。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history
papers.audit_note: The v2 title and resource-system emphasis differ from v1, titled AgentFly: Extensible and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for LM Agents. Distinct from the unrelated AgentFly paper arXiv:2508.16153.

papers.title: SkyRL-Agent: Efficient RL Training for Multi-turn LLM Agent
papers.name: SkyRL-Agent
papers.summary_en: Provides an agent layer with asynchronous pipeline dispatch, lightweight tool integration, and interoperability with multiple training backends. Demonstrates long-horizon training through software-engineering, research, computer-use, and memory agents.
papers.summary_zh: 提供包含异步流水线调度、轻量工具接入和多训练后端互操作的智能体层。通过软件工程、研究、计算机操作及记忆智能体展示长时域训练。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: AgentGym-RL: Training LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Decision Making through Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
papers.name: AgentGym-RL
papers.summary_en: Offers a modular, decoupled framework for multi-turn RL across interactive environments. ScalingInter-RL gradually increases interaction horizons to manage exploration, exploitation, and optimization stability.
papers.summary_zh: 提供跨交互环境的模块化、解耦多轮 RL 框架。ScalingInter-RL 逐步增加交互时域，以平衡探索、利用和优化稳定性。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: RAGEN: Understanding Self-Evolution in LLM Agents via Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
papers.name: RAGEN
papers.summary_en: Introduces a modular agent-training system and trajectory-level StarPO optimization. Studies unstable multi-turn learning and stabilizes it through trajectory filtering, a critic, and gradient stabilization in the reviewed revision.
papers.summary_zh: 提出模块化智能体训练系统和轨迹级 StarPO 优化。研究多轮学习不稳定问题，并在所核验版本中通过轨迹过滤、评价网络及梯度稳定化进行改进。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history
papers.audit_note: Use the v2 description; v1 and v2 differ in experiment scope and stabilization wording. The original repository URL RAGEN-AI/RAGEN redirects to mll-lab-nu/RAGEN.

papers.title: Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.name: Molt
papers.summary_en: Combines PyTorch and Hugging Face models with compatible agent interfaces, context-compaction handling, fully asynchronous training, and distributed experience storage. Targets experimentation with large policies and long multimodal trajectories.
papers.summary_zh: 结合 PyTorch 与 Hugging Face 模型、兼容的智能体接口、上下文压缩处理、全异步训练和分布式经验存储。面向大规模策略及长多模态轨迹上的研究迭代。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history
papers.audit_note: The summary follows v3 from September 22 rather than the differently worded initial search-index abstract.

papers.title: Rollout-Training Co-Design for Efficient LLM-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.name: FlexMARL
papers.summary_en: Coordinates LLM-based multi-agent rollout and training through an experience store and micro-batch asynchronous pipeline. Uses hierarchical rollout balancing and agent-centric allocation with training-state swapping.
papers.summary_zh: 通过经验存储和微批次异步流水线，协调基于 LLM 的多智能体采样与训练。采用分层采样负载均衡，以及结合训练状态换入换出的智能体级资源分配。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: AReaL: A Large-Scale Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning System for Language Reasoning
papers.name: AReaL
papers.summary_en: Decouples continuous rollout generation from batched policy updates. Controls data staleness through workload balancing and a staleness-enhanced PPO variant; the paper evaluates language reasoning rather than a general environment API.
papers.summary_zh: 将持续采样生成与批次策略更新解耦。通过工作负载平衡和考虑陈旧度的 PPO 变体控制数据陈旧度；论文评测聚焦语言推理，而非通用环境接口。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history
papers.audit_note: The paper links inclusionAI/AReaL, which now redirects to areal-project/AReaL. Paper-version claims are separate from current repository capabilities.

papers.title: StreamRL: Scalable, Heterogeneous, and Elastic RL for LLMs with Disaggregated Stream Generation
papers.name: StreamRL
papers.summary_en: Separates generation and training resources, then uses stream generation to overlap stages. An output-length ranker guides skewness-aware dispatch to reduce long-tail stalls, including heterogeneous deployment settings.
papers.summary_zh: 分离生成与训练资源，并通过流式生成重叠不同阶段。利用输出长度排序模型指导长尾感知调度，减少长尾停顿，并研究异构部署场景。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: AsyncFlow: An Asynchronous Streaming RL Framework for Efficient LLM Post-Training
papers.name: AsyncFlow
papers.summary_en: Uses distributed storage and transfer to stream RL data between components with fine-grained scheduling. A producer-consumer workflow overlaps tasks and defers parameter updates within staleness limits while decoupling backend engines.
papers.summary_zh: 通过分布式存储和传输，以细粒度调度在组件间流式传递 RL 数据。生产者—消费者工作流重叠执行任务，在陈旧度限制内推迟参数更新，并解耦底层引擎。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: Part II: ROLL Flash -- Accelerating RLVR and Agentic Training with Asynchrony
papers.name: ROLL Flash
papers.summary_en: Extends ROLL with fine-grained parallelism and rollout-training separation. Queue scheduling and asynchronous environment execution support RLVR and agentic training, paired with evaluation of off-policy optimization methods.
papers.summary_zh: 通过细粒度并行与采样训练分离扩展 ROLL。队列调度和异步环境执行支持 RLVR 及智能体训练，并配合对离策略优化方法的评估。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: RollArt: Disaggregated Multi-Task Agentic RL Training at Scale
papers.name: RollArt
papers.summary_en: Maps prefill, decoding, and environments to suitable hardware and separates rollout components at trajectory granularity. Stateless reward computation uses serverless infrastructure, while bounded-staleness weight synchronization overlaps rollout and training.
papers.summary_zh: 将预填充、解码和环境执行映射到适合的硬件，并在轨迹粒度分离采样组件。无状态奖励计算使用无服务器基础设施，通过有界陈旧度的权重同步重叠采样与训练。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history
papers.audit_note: Use the v2 title and mechanism description; v1 was titled RollArt: Scaling Agentic RL Training via Disaggregated Infrastructure and used RollArc in its abstract.

papers.title: DORA: A Scalable Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning System for Language Model Training
papers.name: DORA
papers.summary_en: Uses multi-version streaming rollout to overlap generation and training under long-tailed workloads. Frames system design around intra-trajectory policy consistency, data integrity, and bounded staleness.
papers.summary_zh: 使用多版本流式采样，在长尾工作负载下重叠生成与训练。围绕轨迹内策略一致性、数据完整性和有界陈旧度设计系统。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: WAR: Workload-Aware Rollouts for Synchronous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.name: WAR
papers.summary_en: Optimizes synchronous agentic rollout according to runtime load: suffix-based speculative decoding at low load and cache-aware placement at high load. The scheduler considers cache locality, trajectory progress, and replica load.
papers.summary_zh: 根据运行负载优化同步智能体采样：低负载使用基于后缀的推测解码，高负载采用缓存感知放置。调度器综合缓存局部性、轨迹进度及副本负载。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: VenusRL: A Fully Disaggregated Agentic RL System with Priority Scheduling and Scalable Interaction
papers.name: VenusRL
papers.summary_en: Prioritizes sample groups likely to unblock the next update across admission, KV-cache residency, and worker placement. Combines memory-aware sandbox admission with template-based page sharing and copy-on-write.
papers.summary_zh: 在准入、KV 缓存驻留和工作节点放置中，优先处理更可能推动下一次更新的样本组。结合内存感知的沙箱准入、基于模板的页面共享和写时复制。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: RollPacker: Mitigating Long-Tail Rollouts for Fast, Synchronous RL Post-Training
papers.name: RollPacker
papers.summary_en: Groups prompts that produce long responses into designated long rounds while keeping most synchronous rollout rounds short. Combines this tail-batching strategy with elastic rollout parallelism, reward scheduling, and streaming training.
papers.summary_zh: 将易产生长回答的提示集中到指定长轮次，使多数同步采样轮次保持较短。将这种尾部批处理与弹性采样并行、奖励调度和流式训练结合。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: HybridFlow: A Flexible and Efficient RLHF Framework
papers.name: HybridFlow / verl
papers.summary_en: Combines single-controller and multi-controller execution to express RLHF dataflow with distributed models. Its hybrid engine reshards actor parameters between training and generation; this is foundational RL infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh: 结合单控制器与多控制器执行，表达包含分布式模型的 RLHF 数据流。其混合引擎在训练与生成之间重分片策略模型参数，属于基础 RL 训练设施。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history
papers.audit_note: The original volcengine/verl repository redirects to verl-project/verl. Current agent support is not attributed retroactively to the original paper.

papers.title: ReaL: Efficient RLHF Training of Large Language Models with Parameter Reallocation
papers.name: ReaL / ReaLHF
papers.summary_en: Changes parallelization and resource allocation across RLHF workloads by redistributing model parameters. Searches for execution plans using a runtime estimator and executes the chosen plan with a distributed runtime.
papers.summary_zh: 通过重新分配模型参数，在不同 RLHF 工作负载之间调整并行策略与资源分配。利用运行时间估计器搜索执行计划，再由分布式运行时执行所选计划。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history
papers.audit_note: The reviewed title uses ReaL, while the repository remains ReaLHF. GitHub marks the repository archived as of the review date.

papers.title: OpenRLHF: An Easy-to-use, Scalable and High-performance RLHF Framework
papers.name: OpenRLHF
papers.summary_en: Provides a scalable RLHF and RLVR framework built on Ray, vLLM, DeepSpeed, and Hugging Face Transformers. The reviewed paper emphasizes coordinating training and inference with an accessible implementation.
papers.summary_zh: 提供基于 Ray、vLLM、DeepSpeed 和 Hugging Face Transformers 的可扩展 RLHF 与 RLVR 框架。所核验论文强调训练推理协调，以及便于使用的实现。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: RLinf: Flexible and Efficient Large-scale Reinforcement Learning via Macro-to-Micro Flow Transformation
papers.name: RLinf
papers.summary_en: Transforms high-level RL workflows into optimized temporal and spatial execution flows. Adaptive communication, context switching, elastic pipelining, and profiling-guided scheduling support reasoning and embodied RL.
papers.summary_zh: 将高层 RL 工作流转换为在时间与空间维度优化的执行流。通过自适应通信、上下文切换、弹性流水线和性能剖析引导的调度，支持推理及具身 RL。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Optimization for Large-Scale Learning: An Efficient and User-Friendly Scaling Library
papers.name: ROLL
papers.summary_en: Uses a single controller and parallel-worker abstraction to compose RL pipelines. Sample-lifecycle scheduling, environment and reward workers, data transfer, and flexible device mapping support agentic experimentation.
papers.summary_zh: 使用单控制器和并行工作单元抽象组织 RL 流水线。通过样本生命周期调度、环境与奖励工作单元、数据传输和灵活设备映射，支持智能体实验。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: AgentGym: Evolving Large Language Model-based Agents across Diverse Environments
papers.name: AgentGym
papers.summary_en: Provides diverse interactive environments with a unified format and concurrent exploration, together with trajectories and benchmarks. Supplies environment infrastructure and an agent-evolution method rather than a distributed RL trainer.
papers.summary_zh: 提供统一格式、支持并发探索的多种交互环境，以及轨迹数据和评测基准。贡献环境基础设施与智能体演化方法，而非分布式 RL 训练器。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: Training Software Engineering Agents and Verifiers with SWE-Gym
papers.name: SWE-Gym
papers.summary_en: Packages software-engineering tasks with repositories, executable environments, and unit tests. Supports training agents and trajectory verifiers; it supplies task infrastructure rather than an asynchronous RL execution engine.
papers.summary_zh: 将软件工程任务与代码仓库、可执行环境和单元测试打包。支持训练智能体及轨迹验证器；提供任务基础设施，而非异步 RL 执行引擎。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: SWE-smith: Scaling Data for Software Engineering Agents
papers.name: SWE-smith
papers.summary_en: Builds execution environments from Python repositories and synthesizes task instances that break existing tests. Scales software-engineering training data and associated runtime environments rather than introducing an RL optimizer.
papers.summary_zh: 从 Python 仓库构建执行环境，并合成使现有测试失败的任务实例。扩展软件工程训练数据及配套运行环境，而非提出 RL 优化器。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: SWE-Factory: Your Automated Factory for Issue Resolution Training Data and Evaluation Benchmarks
papers.name: SWE-Factory
papers.summary_en: Automates issue-resolution dataset construction through binary-test recovery, multi-agent environment setup, and exit-code-based fail-to-pass validation. Supports training-data and evaluation-environment preparation.
papers.summary_zh: 通过二进制测试恢复、多智能体环境搭建，以及基于退出码的失败到通过验证，自动构建问题修复数据集。支持准备训练数据和评测环境。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: The Rollout Infrastructure Tax in Coding-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.name: Rollout Infrastructure Tax
papers.summary_en: Compares containers, hosted sandboxes, Kubernetes-managed containers, and cloud VMs as coding-agent execution substrates. Measures startup overhead and projects rollout worker costs; this is a measurement study, not a new trainer.
papers.summary_zh: 比较容器、托管沙箱、Kubernetes 管理的容器和云虚拟机作为编码智能体执行底座的表现。测量启动开销并估算采样工作成本；属于测量研究，而非新训练框架。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.name: SAO
papers.summary_en: Replaces group-wise sampling with one rollout per prompt, combined with value-model training and double-sided token clipping. Studies the stability and off-policy implications of asynchronous agent training; primarily an optimization method.
papers.summary_zh: 以每个提示采样一条轨迹替代分组采样，结合价值模型训练与词元级双侧裁剪。研究异步智能体训练的稳定性及离策略影响，主要贡献是优化方法。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: Missing Old Logits in Asynchronous Agentic RL: Semantic Mismatch and Repair Methods for Off-Policy Correction
papers.name: Missing Old Logits
papers.summary_en: Distinguishes training-inference distribution mismatch from policy staleness when historical training-side logits are missing. Analyzes version snapshots, a dedicated old-policy model, partial-rollout synchronization, and approximate correction.
papers.summary_zh: 在缺少历史训练侧 logits 时，区分训练推理分布差异与策略陈旧度。分析版本快照、专用旧策略模型、部分轨迹同步，以及近似校正方案。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history
papers.audit_note: The reviewed v3 abstract does not identify an official implementation repository; no implementation link is inferred from earlier search snippets.

papers.title: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL
papers.name: RAGEN-2
papers.summary_en: Diagnoses input-agnostic reasoning templates that can persist despite stable entropy using mutual-information proxies. Uses reward-variance-based filtering to retain stronger training signals; included for online observability and sample-selection implications.
papers.summary_zh: 利用互信息代理指标，诊断在熵稳定时仍可能存在的、与输入无关的推理模板。通过基于奖励方差的过滤保留较强训练信号；因其对在线观测和样本选择的启示而收录。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history

papers.title: AsyncWebRL: Efficient Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Step Visual Web Agents
papers.name: AsyncWebRL
papers.summary_en: Overlaps rollout, gradient updates, and policy refresh using a persistent rollout pool and lightweight screenshot handling. Also changes multi-step GRPO normalization to address inefficient trajectories and token usage.
papers.summary_zh: 通过持续采样池与轻量截图处理，重叠轨迹采样、梯度更新和策略刷新。还调整多步 GRPO 归一化，以处理轨迹和词元使用效率问题。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history
papers.audit_note: The arXiv record gives June 4 as the first submission; do not infer June 6 from a secondary index.

papers.title: RLinf-VLA: A Unified and Efficient Framework for Reinforcement Learning of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.name: RLinf-VLA
papers.summary_en: Unifies VLA architectures, RL algorithms, and heterogeneous simulators. Coordinates rendering, inference, and training with flexible resource allocation and a hybrid fine-grained pipeline; an embodied extension of the main scope.
papers.summary_zh: 统一 VLA 架构、RL 算法和异构模拟器。通过灵活资源分配与混合细粒度流水线协调渲染、推理及训练，属于本目录主题的具身扩展。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history
papers.audit_note: The reviewed v3 title expands VLA+RL to Reinforcement Learning of Vision-Language-Action Models.

papers.title: Next-Generation Agentic Reinforcement Learning Systems Enable Self-Evolving Agents
papers.name: AReaL 2.0 / Self-Evolving Agent Systems
papers.summary_en: Argues for step-level trajectory protocols, governed data proxies, and a control plane for agent evolution. Instantiates policy-weight updates through AReaL 2.0; a systems position and architecture paper, not proof of every proposed evolution mechanism.
papers.summary_zh: 主张建设步骤级轨迹协议、受治理的数据代理及智能体演化控制平面。通过 AReaL 2.0 实现策略权重更新；属于系统立场与架构论文，不代表所有提议的演化机制均已得到验证。
papers.evidence: arXiv abstract, bibliographic metadata, and submission history
